Line bounce: a step down a transmission line, arrival by arrival

Set the driver, the line and the load. See the far end ring or climb, arrival by arrival, and which termination makes it clean.

This page sets no cookie and sends nothing anywhere.

Where the numbers come from
  • gHashTag/t27 specs/fpga/line_bounce.t27 (t27#8931): every value on the page is its fn bodies, compiled to wasm (logic.js), with 7 tests
  • H. Johnson, M. Graham, High-Speed Digital Design, 1993, ch. 4: the lattice of VS 1 V, RS 25 ohm, Z0 50 ohm, open end: 1.333, 0.889, 1.037, 0.988 V
  • E. Bogatin, Signal and Power Integrity -- Simplified, 3rd ed., ch. 8: reflection coefficient (R - Z0) / (R + Z0) and termination
